# FocusTube

> Convert any YouTube playlist into a distraction-free, structured course. Free. No sign-up required.

## What is FocusTube?

FocusTube is a free web application that turns any public YouTube playlist into a clean, LMS-style learning experience. It removes YouTube's sidebar, recommendations, comments, and autoplay distractions, letting you focus entirely on studying.

## URL

https://focus-tube-chi.vercel.app/

## Key Features

- **YouTube Playlist to Course**: Paste any YouTube playlist URL to instantly create a structured course dashboard.
- **Progress Tracking**: Each video is individually tracked. Your progress is saved automatically.
- **Timestamped Notes**: Take notes while watching with a single click. Notes are anchored to the exact video timestamp and saved permanently.
- **Offline-First**: All data is saved locally in your browser. No internet required after initial load.
- **Cloud Sync**: Optional Google Sign-In syncs your progress and courses across all your devices via Firebase.
- **Creator Mode**: Educators and content creators can publish a YouTube playlist as a shareable course with an optional access password. Students access it via a unique share link.
- **Dark / Light Mode**: Full theme support.
- **Export Study Guide**: Export all your notes for a course as a Markdown file.

## Who is it for?

- Students using YouTube for self-study (MOOCs, university lectures, tutorial playlists)
- Educators who want to package a YouTube playlist as a simple course for students
- Anyone who wants a distraction-free way to watch and learn from YouTube playlists

## Technology

- Pure HTML, CSS, and vanilla JavaScript (no framework)
- Firebase Authentication (Google Sign-In) and Firestore for cloud sync
- YouTube IFrame Player API for video playback
- Hosted on Vercel
